findings.title: Archived Postgres MCP server
findings.detail: This Postgres MCP server was archived on 2025-05-29. Its read-only mode runs queries in a read-only transaction that a stacked COMMIT; can end (Datadog Security Labs). If its database role can write, the agent can write.
fix: Give the server a role that can only SELECT.
Or route it through Deedglass: deedglass mcp wrap --connector <name> -- <the server's command>.

findings.title: A database URL sits in a client config
findings.detail: Server "postgres" has a database URL in its arguments, so the password travels with the file.
fix: Move it to an environment variable the client reads, so it isn't copied with the file.

policies.why: DROP and TRUNCATE never run, whatever the agent sends.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-block-destructive-sql
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the postgres-safe starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

rules:
  - id: block-destructive-sql
    match: { connector_type: postgres }
    when: sql.kind in ["drop", "truncate"]
    decision: deny
    reason: DROP and TRUNCATE are never allowed for agents.
    notify: [slack]

policies.why: Writes wait for a person in Console › Approvals.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-writes-need-approval
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the postgres-safe starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

rules:
  - id: writes-need-approval
    match: { tool: postgres.execute }
    when: sql.category == "write"
    decision: require_approval
    reason: Writes to this database wait for a human. An admin can approve in Console › Approvals.
    approval: { approvers: [role:admin], required: 1, expires_in: 30m }
    notify: [email, slack]
    verify: L2

policies.why: More than $500.00 of refunds in a day waits until the next day.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-refunds-per-day
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the stripe-refunds starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

budgets:
  - id: refunds-per-day
    description: At most $500.00 of USD refunds a day, across every agent in the org.
    match: { tool: stripe.create_refund }
    per: org
    window: day
    max_spend: "500.00 usd"
    # The measure is in single quotes because it contains " : ". In plain YAML
    # that reads as a new key, and the file would not load. Only refunds whose
    # charge Stripe confirmed as USD count; other currencies go to a person
    # ("non-usd-refunds-need-approval"), and a refund with no whole-number
    # amount counts as 0 here ("refunds-need-an-amount" refuses it).
    measure: 'request.stripe.enriched && request.stripe.currency == "usd" && has(args.amount) && type(args.amount) == int ? args.amount : 0'
